title: Equality of the Empty-Prefix Images
statement: Let $B$ and $F$ be Boolean finite Turing machines, let $a$ be a state of $B$, and let $f,s$ be Boolean values. For an input word $x$, a configuration $c$ of $B$ on $x$, a release bit $r$, an optional flag bit $g$, a counter word $w$, and a configuration $e$ of $F$ on $x$, if the output of $c$ is empty, then the loop-body image with direction $f$, startup marker $s$, and empty prefix, applied to the padded configuration built from $c,r,g,w,e$, equals the loop-call configuration built from those same data and startup marker $s$.
hypotheses_covered: $B$ and $F$ are Boolean finite Turing machines
